capabilities: Parse local VCALENDAR, VEVENT, VTODO, and VTIMEZONE data
Group event and task lists by date or component type
Filter events by text and date range
Show event details and source lines
Fall back to raw source view
disambiguation: Not a calendar sync or CalDAV client; it only opens local .ics files read-only for inspection.
extras: Strictly read-only and offline: never syncs, fetches remote URLs, imports, or writes back to .ics files, and its runtime code avoids network, clipboard, eval, and process APIs. Large files are bounded by parse/render caps. Documentation is the README only.
intentEvidence: ICS Calendar Viewer deliberately stays file-inspection first: open a local .ics, inspect what is inside
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open and inspect the contents of local .ics calendar files.

relations.evidence: ICS imports events from calendar/ICS URLs into Daily Notes.
Full Calendar provides a full calendar UI with read-only ICS/CalDAV remote calendars.
MemoChron focuses on calendar integration and event notes.
iCal generates iCal from vault tasks.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens local .ics calendar files as an inspection surface with event lists, filters, details, and raw source fallback.
